title: Understanding Adjusted R-Squared: Key Differences from R-Squared Explained

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we're continuing our saga of model evaluation, and we're talking about Adjusted R Squared.
cues.zh: 繼續模型評估，今天介紹調整後 R²。

cues.en: Previously we discussed R Squared, which is defined as one minus the residual sum of squared divided by the total sum of squared and R Squared is a goodness of fit.
cues.zh: 前面介紹 R²，定義為 1 減去殘差平方和除以總平方和，用來衡量擬合優度。

cues.en: For our models, greater is better.
cues.zh: 對模型而言，數值越大越好。

cues.en: Just a quick reminder, we mentioned that R Squared is between zero and one, and that there is no overarching rule of thumb.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，曾提到 R² 在 0 到 1 之間，但沒有通用的判斷準則。

cues.en: The values really depend on the industry and use case.
cues.zh: 數值好壞取決於產業與使用情境。

cues.en: So, for some industries and use cases, 0.9 might be a great R Squared and 0.4 might be a terrible R Squared.
cues.zh: 有些產業或情境，0.9 很好，0.4 很差。

cues.en: For other industries and use cases, 0.4 might be a great R Squared.
cues.zh: 但在另一些情況，0.4 可能已經很好。

cues.en: So, it really depends.
cues.zh: 必須看情境。

cues.en: However, there is an overarching problem across the board which is to do with adding new independent variables.
cues.zh: 不過，有個共同問題：增加新的自變數。

cues.en: So, let's say we have a linear regression with two independent variables and we decide to add a third one.
cues.zh: 假設線性迴歸原本有兩個自變數，現在決定加第三個。

cues.en: For example, we got new data, a new column of data, or we got, we're just trying to explore and see what other variables might be helpful
cues.zh: 可能取得新的資料欄位，也可能只是探索其他變數，看看能否幫助

cues.en: in the explanation in our model.
cues.zh: 模型解釋資料。

cues.en: So, what happens when we add another variable is that the total sum of squares doesn't change because it only depends on the average of the y actual values
cues.zh: 加入變數時，總平方和不變，因為只取決於實際 y 的平均，

cues.en: and doesn't depend on the y-hat values.
cues.zh: 不依賴預測值 ŷ。

cues.en: But the residual sum of squares will change and in fact it will only either decrease or stay the same.
cues.zh: 但殘差平方和會變，而且只會下降或維持不變。

cues.en: The problem we are facing is that the residual sum of squares will never increase when we try to add another variable, and this might not be intuitive at first,
cues.zh: 問題是，增加變數時，殘差平方和永遠不會上升。這一開始可能不直覺，

cues.en: so let's talk about it a little bit.
cues.zh: 所以稍微解釋。

cues.en: The main reason for this is that we are using the Ordinary Least Squares method to build our models.
cues.zh: 主要原因，是模型用普通最小平方法建立。

cues.en: And what the Ordinary Least Squares method does is it aims to minimize the residual sum of squares.
cues.zh: 它的目標就是最小化殘差平方和。

cues.en: So, let's try, see this in action.
cues.zh: 看看實際發生什麼。

cues.en: When we add this new variable, X3, the Ordinary Least Squared method is going to look for coefficient b3 that improve the yi-hat predicted values.
cues.zh: 加入新變數 x3 時，最小平方法會尋找能改善 ŷi 預測的係數 b3。

cues.en: As long as it finds a coefficient b3 where the yi-hat values are better than they were before, closer to the actual values,
cues.zh: 只要找到某個 b3，使 ŷi 比以前更好、更接近實際值，

cues.en: then the residual sum of squares will improve.
cues.zh: 殘差平方和就會改善。

cues.en: It could improve by a lot if the prediction is much better now or it can improve by a tiny little bit, even if the prediction is a little bit better.
cues.zh: 若預測改善很多，平方和就大幅減少；即使只改善一點，也會略微減少。

cues.en: Now in the situation where the Ordinary Least Squares method cannot find a coefficient b3 that improves the predictions,
cues.zh: 如果找不到能改善預測的 b3，

cues.en: like all possible coefficients b3 make the predictions worse, then the Ordinary Least Squared method is just going to be very smart or sneaky you can call it.
cues.zh: 所有係數都會讓結果更差，最小平方法就會很聰明，或說取巧，

cues.en: And it's just going to turn b3 into zero.
cues.zh: 直接把 b3 設為 0。

cues.en: It's just going to say, okay, we are going to set b3 at zero and that means even though we technically added an extra variable, it's not participating at all in the predictions
cues.zh: 它會說，將 b3 設為 0。雖然技術上增加了變數，卻完全不參與預測，

cues.en: because its coefficient is zero.
cues.zh: 因為係數是 0。

cues.en: So, in that case, the residual sum of squares won't change, will be exactly as it was before.
cues.zh: 此時殘差平方和保持和以前一樣。

cues.en: So, we end up with a situation where we can just keep adding more and more variables that maybe have even nothing to do with our problem at hand.
cues.zh: 因此，可以一直加入更多變數，即使和問題毫無關係。

cues.en: But by virtue of some random correlations, our R Squared in some cases will be improving, improving, improving.
cues.zh: 但由於某些隨機關聯，R² 有時還會不斷提高。

cues.en: It never gets worse.
cues.zh: 永遠不會變差。

cues.en: So, the residual sum of squares will decrease.
cues.zh: 因為殘差平方和下降，

cues.en: That means R Squared will increase.
cues.zh: R² 就上升。

cues.en: And that's a problem because we don't want to end up with models that have lots of variables that have nothing to do with that model, that are not really adding a lot of value,
cues.zh: 我們不希望模型包含很多無關、沒有真正價值的變數，

cues.en: but in general are just increasing R Squared.
cues.zh: 卻只是在提高 R²。

cues.en: So, what is the solution?
cues.zh: 解法是什麼？

cues.en: The solution is a new version of R Squared, an Adjusted R Squared, and that's exactly what it's called.
cues.zh: 使用 R² 的新版本，也就是調整後 R²。

cues.en: It is calculated with this scary looking formula.
cues.zh: 透過這個看起來嚇人的公式計算。

cues.en: But as you'll see from the practical tutorials with Adlan, it's not scary at all, and you'll be able to recreate this, actually, manually.
cues.zh: 但 Hadelin 的實作會證明它一點也不可怕，甚至能手動重現。

cues.en: So, here there are a couple of new parameters.
cues.zh: 這裡有幾個新參數。

cues.en: k is the number of independent variables that are in our model, and n is the sample size.
cues.zh: k 是模型中自變數數量，n 是樣本數。

cues.en: And the important thing here is to look at k.
cues.zh: 重點是 k。

cues.en: So if we, if k increases over here, then the denominator decreases.
cues.zh: 如果 k 增加，分母就減少。

cues.en: That means the whole ratio increases.
cues.zh: 整個比值會增加。

cues.en: And because it's being subtracted, that means Adjusted R Square decreases.
cues.zh: 因為這一項被減掉，所以調整後 R² 下降。

cues.en: So, that's the important point here, that this new formula penalizes us for adding additional variables.
cues.zh: 重點就是，這個公式會對增加變數施加懲罰。

cues.en: So, basically it's only worth adding an extra variable if R Squared, this original R Squared, if it increases substantially enough
cues.zh: 只有當原始 R² 增加得夠多，

cues.en: that compensates for this penalty.
cues.zh: 能抵銷懲罰時，才值得加入新變數。

cues.en: So, when you're adding new variables becomes something that has to be justified.
cues.zh: 因此，新增變數必須有理由。

cues.en: If it's not justified, then the new variable's not worth adding.
cues.zh: 沒有合理理由，就不值得加入。

cues.en: And that's what Adjusted R Squared is about.
cues.zh: 這就是調整後 R² 的意義。

cues.en: It's about making sure that we only add variables when they bring substantial improvement to our model.
cues.zh: 確保只有能實質改善模型的變數，才被加入。

cues.en: So, there you go, that's Adjusted R Squared.
cues.zh: 以上就是調整後 R²。

cues.en: Hope you enjoy this tutorial and I'll see you next time.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡這個教學，下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
